title: Revision Days for Revised Source Estimates — Insurance Claim Repairs Planning Notes
content:
**Rule.** Revision days in the planned repair days of an Insurance Claim Repairs repair order follow the revisions recorded on the estimate the repair order was converted from, in that booking's history under Repair Estimates & Appointments: two or more revisions add the two-revision days, **2 days**; exactly one revision adds the one-revision days, **1 day**; and none adds nothing.

### Questions answered by the rule

**Where are the revisions counted?** On the source estimate booking — the estimate the repair order was converted from — as the revisions recorded in its history.

**How many days does a single revision add?** 1 day.

**Does a third or fourth revision add more than a second?** No. Two or more revisions add 2 days, however many there are beyond two.

**What if the source estimate was never revised?** No revision days are added.

| Revisions recorded on the source estimate | Revision days |
|---|---|
| 0 | none |
| 1 | 1 |
| 2 | 2 |
| 3 or more | 2 |
